failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Battle of Harlem Heights September 16 1776 Battle of White Plains October 28 1776' | Hop 3 query: 'What were the dates and locations of the Battle of Harlem Heights and the Battle of White Plains, and how do these two battles differ as part of the New York and New Jersey campaign?' Both queries target the same information (dates and locations of the two battles) already fully provided in hop 1 passages. Hop 1 retrieval returned passages explicitly stating Battle of Harlem Heights was September 16, 1776 in Manhattan and Battle of White Plains was October 28, 1776 near White Plains. Summaries 1 and 2 both acknowledge these facts are verified, yet hop 3 re-asks for the same date and location information.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 includes detailed analysis of passages about unrelated battles and military units: '10th Continental Regiment' (passage 7), 'Battle of Long Island' (passage 6), 'Battle of Pell's Point' (passage 3), and 'Battle of Mamaroneck' (passage 5). None of these passages are relevant to verifying the claim's conflation of Battle of Harlem Heights with the October 28, 1776 date. The solver processes all 7 passages when only passages 1, 2, and 4 (Battle of White Plains, Battle of Harlem Heights, and New York and New Jersey campaign) are needed to identify the factual error.
